content: He who is not courageous enough to take risks will accomplish nothing in life.
author: Muhammad Ali
story:
Preserved as part of Muhammad Ali's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of risk and courage. Across his life and work, Muhammad Ali returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What authentic choice would you make right now if fear were completely off the table?
